records.summary: 多流体时间色散矩阵：Assemble the independently corrected local fluid/Maxwell generator and relativistic inertia.。
records.definition: For k=(kx,0,kz), eps=(epsx,epsy,0): dn_dot=-i(k.v0)dn-n0*(i*k+eps).dv. Momentum A_v*d(v)_dot=-i(k.v0)A_v*dv+(q/m)*(dv cross B0+v0 cross dB+dE)-i*diag(csp2,csp2,csz2)*k*dn/n0+diag(csp2,csp2,csz2)*eps*dn/(gamma*n0)+collision. With D=(Psz-Psp)/B0/rho, add [-i*kz*D*dBx,-i*kz*D*dBy,-2*D*((i*kx+epsx)*dBx+epsy*dBy)] when B0!=0. Maxwell dE_dot=i*c2*(k cross dB)-sum(q*(n0*dv+v0*dn))/epsilon0; dB_dot=-i*(k cross dE). A_v=gamma_rel*I+gamma_rel^3*v0*v0^T/c2 if rel=1. The extra density and magnetic-coefficient gradient terms correct omitted derivatives of the source pressure acceleration. Positive self forcing is replaced by dissipative friction. No Lorentz overwrite correction is claimed: the original Lorentz and anisotropy entries use different columns.
records.model: Algebraic anisotropic multi-fluid closure with empirical longitudinal magnetic-pressure factor two
records.boundary: B0=0 sets director-response terms to zero and retains explicit fixed-z pressure; rel=1 excludes luminal/superluminal drift
assumptions: Effective local algebraic thermal model; not full entropy evolution, CGL, kinetic physics, or the unmagnetized drift-directed Appendix A model.
Background sources and prescribed acceleration per mass have zero perturbation response. Gradients define a local/eikonal symbol, not an inhomogeneous global Maxwell-Gauss boundary solution.
The magnetic longitudinal pressure-divergence factor two is a phenomenological mirror correction; no universal kinetic mirror threshold or experimental accuracy claim.
Relativistic inertia is d(gamma*v)/dv with retained noncovariant pressure and friction; no fully covariant thermodynamics claim.

records.summary: 多流体色散扫描：Run the full retained source scan family through corrected operators with explicit state and limits.。
records.definition: Initialize once; for each source-selected k point assemble the corrected matrix and compute the conditioned eigenspectrum; collect every sorted mode and retain the last-point M,A,w1,w2,state. Methods2/3/4 retain defaults101/196 magnitude points,51 angles,50x75 Cartesian mesh and row-major kz then kx order. Single branch handles0/1 and unknown nonnegative selectors. Then produce a two-panel PNG in Agg for2/3/4; other selectors retain zero axes. Optional SI positional return is (M,A,w1,w2,kk,ww1,ww2,betasz,vA,csz2,c2,rhos0,wcs,qs,ms,wps,B0) prefix, all defined.
records.model: Composition of fresh state, corrected local multi-fluid matrix and conditioned spectrum; source scan grids retained
records.boundary: Entire scan bounded by max_points; failure aborts without partial scientific results; independent sorting is not branch continuation

records.summary: 多流体时间色散谱：Solve and independently sort temporal modes with coherent arity and real precision refinement.。
records.definition: lambda*A*X=M*X; omega=i*lambda. Apply positive diagonal physical and radix-two similarity transforms to both matrices. Initial double eig is followed, when component residual>1e-12, by actual 50-decimal mpmath inversion and eig in a private cloned context. Reject final global or active component residual>1e-10. Convert to complex128 and normalize vectors without overflowing their unscaled magnitudes. Sorting is stable and independent by real/imaginary frequency.
records.model: Dense linear generalized eigenproblem, with backward-error controlled arithmetic refinement
records.boundary: Nonfinite matrices/solutions, singular inertia or excessive residuals fail; repeated modes have arbitrary basis
assumptions: SciPy double arithmetic plus mpmath1.3.0 core for genuine precision fallback.
Accuracy is limited by conditioning and rounded input coefficients; high precision is not a universal forward-error proof.
The retained four/six output vpa order split is intentionally removed; post-eig symbolic conversion provided no additional precision.

records.summary: 多流体等离子体状态：Derive a fresh state, diagnostics and dissipative reciprocal collision matrix.。
records.definition: rho=m*n; Q=sum(q*n); J=sum(q*n*v); P_parallel/perpendicular=rho*cs^2/gamma; omega_c=q*B0/m; omega_p=sqrt(n*q^2/(epsilon0*m)). Pair friction: acceleration_i=sum_j rate_ij*(dv_j-dv_i)-drag_i*dv_i, rho_i rate_ij=rho_j rate_ji.
records.model: Effective local multi-fluid algebraic thermal state with externally supported background
records.boundary: Positive mass/density; B0 may be zero, beta then null; state is recreated independently of prior
assumptions: Effective local algebraic thermal model; not full entropy evolution, CGL, kinetic physics, or the unmagnetized drift-directed Appendix A model.
Background sources and prescribed acceleration per mass have zero perturbation response. Gradients define a local/eikonal symbol, not an inhomogeneous global Maxwell-Gauss boundary solution.
The magnetic longitudinal pressure-divergence factor two is a phenomenological mirror correction; no universal kinetic mirror threshold or experimental accuracy claim.
Relativistic inertia is d(gamma*v)/dv with retained noncovariant pressure and friction; no fully covariant thermodynamics claim.
